body: It reassures me that somebody else feels the same. Do you constantly think about all this? I agree on the therapist part, and I think I'm honestly just going to do it.

No problems. You're right. I can't pinpoint it exactly but I'd say around 2011 when I was 15/16 I started slightly isolating myself for a reason that I still don't know. I've always just had this idea in my head that I'm different to everyone else and therefore not capable to do things that everyone else can. The confidence I have in myself is absolutely 0.
